`docs/mission.md`
If the file is absent, emit an empty Mission Anchor and do not block.
Missing `## Non-goals` or `## Constraints` sections are valid legacy state.
Reject any active `RA###` candidate with an empty reason.
Reject any active `SC###` candidate without an observable criterion and rationale.

Allocate the next never-used ID in that series; do not reuse deprecated IDs
model it as `MODIFY Mission` plus deprecation of the prior active Mission.
Update or curate must resolve duplicate active Missions before adding more state.
Skip deprecated entries unless the user explicitly asks for history.
active `NG###`/`CN###` rows from optional sections that exist.
Both update and curate use this write protocol:
Read the complete file before proposing ADD / MODIFY / DEPRECATE, with a reason for every item.
Confirm only the exact non-empty CHANGESET; any change to its contents requires fresh confirmation.
For `--dry-run` or an empty CHANGESET, stop without confirmation, file creation, writing, updated-date changes, or change-log changes.
Preserve original text, rationale/reason, provenance, stable IDs, and dated deprecation history.
Re-read before committing the complete confirmed file; if the baseline changed, stop and rebuild the CHANGESET for fresh confirmation.
Apply the file, updated date, and change log as one all-or-nothing replacement; on write failure report failure without claiming success.
On retry, read the durable state first; already-applied changes are a no-op and must not duplicate IDs or history.
Do not infer user intent from an onboarding repository scan.
Provide activation guidance only; do not edit AGENTS.md or CODEX.md as part of this skill.

display_name: "YWC Mission"
Use $ywc-mission to read, update, or curate docs/mission.md
user-confirmed CHANGESET.

scenarios.input: Read an absent file; read a legacy file without NG/CN.
scenarios.expected: Empty anchor for absence; existing active Mission/SC/RA anchor for legacy. No writes or migration.

scenarios.input: Create first Mission, SC with rationale, RA with reason; later MODIFY Mission and DEPRECATE rows. Confirm or withhold the exact changeset.
scenarios.expected: Full file read precedes reasoned ADD/MODIFY/DEPRECATE proposal; zero durable writes before exact confirmation; one active Mission afterwards; confirmed modification/deprecation updates history.

scenarios.input: Use either update or curate with --dry-run or no changes.
scenarios.expected: Zero confirmation requests, file creation, content changes, date bumps, or change-log updates.

scenarios.input: Supply SC without observable criterion/rationale, RA without reason, NG without Reason, CN without Rationale.
scenarios.expected: Ask only for missing user facts; exclude invalid candidates and perform zero writes.

scenarios.input: Deprecate NG001/CN001; ask to delete or reuse their IDs; add replacements then deprecate final active rows.
scenarios.expected: Refuse deletion/reuse; allocate next never-used IDs; preserve original text, explanation and provenance in Deprecated; remove empty optional sections and omit deprecated rows from anchor.

scenarios.input: Scan repository for onboarding and create first confirmed mission.
scenarios.expected: Scan does not fabricate intent. After creation provide AGENTS/CODEX activation reminder only; do not modify steering files.

scenarios.input: Baseline changes after confirmation, same confirmed request is retried, or replacement fails.
scenarios.expected: Stale baseline requires a new proposal/confirmation; applied retry is no-op; failed write cannot claim success or partial durable completion.

scenarios.input: Deprecate SC002, NG001 and CN001 with known original rationale/reason and provenance plus a new deprecation reason.
scenarios.expected: Deprecated rows retain original text, original explanation and original provenance in separate Original columns; dated deprecation reason is recorded separately without overwriting the source explanation or provenance.
